title: Boots of Psionic Movement

sources.title: Flying Strike
markers: | description = When a [[githyanki]] casts {{SAI|Fly}}, their next melee weapon attack deals an additional {{DamageText|1d4|Psychic}} damage.

sources.title: Githborn: Flying Boots
markers: | description = Bestow the ability to {{SAI|Fly (class action)|Fly}} upon yourself.

summary: +1 Dexterity saves. Githyanki can use a Bonus Action once per Long Rest to gain Flight for 10 turns. A githyanki who casts Fly adds 1d4 Psychic to their next melee weapon attack within 1 turn.
